notes: P04 candidate algorithm boundary for venue pst (ReceiptMin: Measuring Forensic Reconstructability under Purpose-Bound Audit Minimization). Implemented the isolated ReceiptMin mechanism at evaluation/venue2027/pst/candidate.py (CANDIDATE_ID='clara.pst.candidate.receiptmin', CANDIDATE_ARM_ID='B4', version 1.0.0; describe_mechanism() exposes the machine-readable design record). API: minimize(event, purpose) -> Receipt strips raw sensitive payload per declared purpose and policy epoch, cryptographically binding omitted fields via canonical SHA-256 digest (omitted_field_digest); reconstruct(receipts, query) -> Reconstruction(score, answerable) evaluates ex-ante forensic query answerability (FQ-AUTH-*, FQ-PROV-*, FQ-ELIG-*), failing closed to INDETERMINATE on unknown query, missing key custody, or receipt tampering; run_candidate(case, ctx) -> Outcome maps cases to ADMIT / REJECT / INDETERMINATE for the task harness. Independence: AST scan in test_candidate.py verifies candidate.py imports neither the independent oracle nor label datasets. Unit tests prove positive reconstruction of primary forensic queries, significant byte reduction (>30%) relative to full logs, and fail-closed behavior on adversarial/tampered/unknown queries.
